ns2:course.label: Sculpture II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of ARTS 280. Explores the relationship of sculptural materials and media to meaning; research into the historical, contemporary, and contextual semiotics of materials in order to generate meaning. Prerequisite: ARTS 280.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or New Media major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Class Materials Fee of $50 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
ns2:course.sectionFeeAmount: Undergrad Sculpture A D $50.00 Flat Fee.
